title: Data Center Capacity & Inventory Manager
description:
The Data Center Capacity & Inventory Manager owns a single, accurate, and always-current view of the organization's entire data center estate worldwide. The role exists because the biggest infrastructure decisions - where to place workloads, when to expand or consolidate, and how to plan a move - are only as reliable as the underlying data on power, cooling, racks, and space.
That information is typically fragmented across sites, spreadsheets, and providers. This role consolidates it into one authoritative source of truth, keeps it current, and turns it into capacity forecasts, utilization reporting, and move/migration analysis the business depends on. It is accountable for the inventory and operational data of every facility the organization uses - owned, colocation, and edge.
Scope & Context
• Global portfolio: every data center facility across all regions - company-owned and on-premises sites, colocation and wholesale space, and edge or remote equipment rooms.
• Physical assets: racks and cabinets; power (utility feeds, UPS, generators, PDUs, circuits); cooling (CRAC/CRAH, containment, chilled water); floor, cage, and suite space; structured cabling; and environmental monitoring.
• Data domains: inventory, capacity and utilization, contracts and commitments (colo agreements, power and space reservations), and a history of physical changes.
• Organizational placement: reports into infrastructure/IT leadership and partners with networking, cloud, security, procurement, and finance.
• Key stakeholders: site and facilities teams, colocation providers, infrastructure engineering, capacity planning, finance (cost allocation), and the business units requesting space or moves.
Key Responsibilities
• Define and enforce how every site records and reports its power, cooling, rack, and space configuration, so data is comparable across the portfolio.
• Participate in the the space, power, and cooling analysis behind data center moves, migrations, and consolidations: what fits where, target-site readiness, and the sequencing of each move.
• Supply the accurate capacity and utilization data that drives resourcing and planning decisions
• Manage capacity risk proactively: identify sites approaching power, cooling, or space limits before they constrain the business.
• Uphold resilience, safety, and compliance standards across facilities, including redundancy targets (for example N+1) and disaster-recovery posture.
Inventory, Data & Capacity Management (Core Mandate)
This is the primary purpose of the role: a single, trusted, global source of truth for every data center, kept accurate and current.
Maintain the global inventory and data for all facilities
• A complete register of every data center and equipment room, with location, provider, and contracted commitments.
• Space: floor area, cage and suite allocation, rack and cabinet counts, rack-unit (RU) inventory and occupancy, and remaining white space.
• Power: utility feeds and redundancy, UPS and generator capacity, PDU and circuit inventory, provisioned vs. actual draw (kW) per rack, row, and room, and PUE where measured.
• Cooling: cooling capacity and type, containment, redundancy (N, N+1), temperature and humidity envelopes, and thermal headroom.
• Racks & assets: rack elevations, cabinet layouts, and the physical assets each contains, mapped to their power and connectivity.
Turn that data into decisions
• Track utilization and remaining headroom for space, power, and cooling at rack, row, room, and site level.
• Forecast capacity, flag sites approaching their limits, and recommend expansion, consolidation, or reallocation.
• Provide the analysis behind every move and migration - what a target site can support and how a move should be staged.
• Produce regular reporting and dashboards for leadership, finance, and planning.
Own the tooling and data quality
• Define data standards, naming conventions, and an audit cadence that keep the inventory accurate.
• Run periodic physical audit

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.

Abridge's AI is used by clinicians at hundreds of health systems. As we grow into a multi-product platform, our commercial and business operations are becoming more sophisticated, and each one brings new accounting challenges.

The role has three parts:

- Revenue accounting. Turn those arrangements into accurate, well-documented, audit-ready financials, and get the answer right before the close, not after.

• Du gibst nicht auf, wenn du etwas nicht weißt, sondern findest einen Weg, dir die Antwort zu erarbeiten, bist neugierig, eigeninitiativ und hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

• Du behältst den Überblick über deine Aufgaben, setzt Prioritäten und arbeitest eigenständig, auch wenn mal mehrere Themen parallel laufen.

• Du hast einen hohen Anspruch an dich und deine Arbeit. „Gut genug" reicht dir nicht - du willst liefern, worauf du stolz sein kannst.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team, packst mit an und hast den Anspruch, echte Fortschritte zu ermöglichen.

• Flexibilität lebt. Darunter verstehen wir nicht nur das remote Arbeiten von einem beliebigen Ort, sondern auch den Freiraum das Arbeitsmodell an deine jeweilige Lebenssituation anzupassen.

• Deinen Wert schätzt. Dein Engagement schätzen wir nicht nur mit warmen Worten, sondern mit der entsprechenden top-of-the market Vergütung.

• Unternehmen gründet. Du hast den Freiraum deine eigenen Ideen innerhalb und außerhalb von digetiers zu verwirklichen. Mit Know-How, Geld und unserem Team können wir dich hier unterstützen.

• Als Musketiers zusammenhält. Einer für alle, alle für einen. Wir agieren stets als Team, halten uns den Rücken frei und schenken uns gegenseitiges Vertrauen. Ab Tag eins übernimmst du hier Verantwortung und bekommst ein Umfeld, das dich wachsen lässt.

title: Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager - Brighterly
locationText: Any of our Offices (Kyiv / Lviv / Warsaw) · Remote
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

SKELAR - це venture builder, який будує міжнародні продуктові IT-компанії за правилами світу венчурних інвестицій. Разом із ко-фаундерами збираємо сильні команди, щоб запускати продуктові IT-бізнеси та перемагати на глобальних ринках.

Зараз ми в пошуку Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager.

Brighterly - EdTech-бізнес: навчаємо дітей у США математики та читання. Ми будуємо освітню екосистему, щоб стати «домашньою сторінкою» з вивчення шкільних предметів для дітей та їхніх батьків.

Тисячі дітей щодня проходять уроки на нашій платформі. Бізнес зростає втричі рік до року, а ринок визнав наш продукт: Brighterly очолив рейтинг World's EdTech Rising Stars 2026 за версією журналу TIME.

Зараз працюємо з трьома джерелами трафіку: Meta - основне, TikTok та Google - у стадії R&D. Шукаємо Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager, який візьме на себе зону user acquisition: спершу працюватиме з каналами hands-on, а далі сформує та очолить команду й напрям User Acquisition загалом.

В твою зону відповідальності буде входити:

- Управління та масштабування Meta Ads. Це основний канал трафіку, бюджети на який ростуть щомісяця. Твоє завдання - масштабувати канал, покращуючи ефективність.

- TikTok. Ми вже запустили цей канал, зараз він у стадії R&D, але бачимо позитивну динаміку. Розвитком TikTok уже займається креативний маркетолог, а твоє завдання - взяти на себе user acquisition на цьому сорсі та вивести його на цільові показники.

- Глибока робота з аналітикою: від маркетингових метрик до юніт-економіки та LTV.

- Пошук і тестування нових підходів до залучення користувачів: нетворкінг, відкриті джерела тощо.

- Розвиток автоматизацій для user acquisition. У нас уже є інструмент автоматизації, який закриває частину ручної роботи. Ти зможеш розвивати його, щоб автоматизувати повторювані процеси.

- Побудова процесів і системи ухвалення рішень в User Acquisition. У тебе буде свобода в реалізації ідей.

 

Що для нас важливо:

- 4+ роки в user acquisition / performance-маркетингу

- Досвід масштабування Meta Ads - можеш поділитись кейсом, як виростив(ла) канал і що відбувалося з ефективністю.

- Don't settle for mediocrity: ти не задовольняєшся посереднім результатом, завжди шукаєш, як досягти кращого, і ставиш під сумнів поточні підходи.

- Досвід роботи з TikTok Ads, Google або іншими джерелами трафіку буде плюсом

- Досвід найму та управління командою буде плюсом.

 

Що пропонуємо

- Зону відповідальності з великим впливом на бізнес: user acquisition - один із ключових драйверів росту компанії.

- Можливість стати лідером ключового напряму та побудувати команду в бізнесі, який пройшов «долину смерті» й масштабується.

- Бюджети, які ростуть, і свободу тестувати нові канали та підходи.

Шукаємо людину, яка вже масштабувала paid-канали і хоче взяти на себе user acquisition у швидкозростаючому стартапі з world-class продуктом - спочатку руками, далі з командою.

Окрім бізнесів, ми маємо Благодійний фонд SKELAR, який допомагає із забезпеченням українських захисників та захисниць амуніцією та технікою, а також підтримує зовнішні military-проєкти.

SKELAR - середовище для самореалізації людей, які здатні створити успішні компанії. Ми такі компанії називаємо the next big everything. Віримо в їх потужність та масштаб.

Ми плануємо й надалі розвивати tech-бізнеси, підкорювати глобальні ринки та працювати задля перемоги України 🇺🇦

Для цього створили всі можливості всередині нашого venture builder’a:

- 8 інфраструктурних команд, які допомагають стартапам закривати будь-які питання: від рекрутингу до фінансів та юридичних питань.

- Спільнота фаундерів, які вже запустили не один бізнес й можуть ділитися практичним досвідом.

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар та психолог.

Expect to work across cloud posture, identity, attack paths, prioritization, detection, and adjacent areas as the product evolves. The pace is high. AI is part of how we work, every day.
Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and ship product features end-to-end: from security research to architecture and production code to release.

• Apply cybersecurity expertise to every feature decision: what to detect, how to model risk, what makes a finding actionable, where customers will be misled by noise, and howto translate raw cloud signal into something a security team can trust and act on.

• Own cloud security capabilities across CSPM and beyond: posture, identity, attack paths, severity/prioritization, detections, and emerging areas of the platform.

• Drive AI into the development loop. Use coding agents and LLM tools as a core part of how you design, prototype, build, debug, review, and document. Write strong prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and turn AI-generated work into production-quality code and logic.

• Move fast, with judgment. Make tradeoffs explicit, ship iteratively, and learn from real customer signals.

• Collaborate closely with product, research, and engineering peers: clear written specs, sharp communication, clean handoffs, customer-facing rationale.

Requirements
Requirements:

• 5+ years as a software engineer. You design systems, write production code, reason about reliability and edge cases, and own delivery end-to-end.

• Strong cybersecurity foundation. You understand threats, controls, identity, cloud risk, and why a “finding” is or isn’t worth a customer’s attention. This is what makes your feature decisions land.

• Hands-on experience developing with AI / AI-driven development. This is a MUST.

• You have meaningfully shipped work where coding agents, LLM tools, or in-IDE AI assistants were a core part of how you built it. You can speak in detail about what worked, what didn’t, and how you got real leverage out of these tools.

• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valid).

• Comfortable operating at high pace: small batches, fast iteration, willingness to cut scope to ship, calm under pressure.

• Strong communication: you can explain engineering and security tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

• Experience building CSPM/CNAPP products, cloud security detection/analytics pipelines, or other top-tier security products.

• Experience building or fine-tuning AI-powered developer workflows: custom agents, pipelines, evals, internal AI tooling, prompt frameworks.

• Familiarity with cloud telemetry/log sources and correlating security signals across configuration, identity, and activity.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and cloud-native development experience.

• Prior security research background: vulnerability research, threat research, or detection engineering.

title: Sr. Founding Product Engineer
description:
About Teamified :
Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
About the client:
Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.
The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.
The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.
As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.
About the role:
We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You plan your own work, set your own technical direction within the product brief, and ship. There is no CTO above you and no agency to lean on - you are the engineering function, working at speed with AI-first tooling and agentic coding workflows.

• Own the AI Coach: prompting, conversation state and progression, retrieval (Pinecone), model selection and evaluation, and the safety/crisis layer - tested against scripted clinical scenarios

• Own the backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS (Sydney)

• Own mobile and web delivery: React Native (iOS + Android) and React, including App Store / Google Play / Stripe subscriptions

• Own release engineering: CI/CD, environments, signing credentials, monitoring, backups, rollback - built for fast, safe, frequent releases

• Bring a product eye: you care how screens look and feel on mobile and web, not just whether the API returns 200

• Translate technical decisions into plain language for the founder and clinical team

How you work (this is the core of the role):
You are an AI-first engineer. You use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) as your default workflow - planning, generating, reviewing and shipping with AI leverage rather than writing everything by hand. You build evaluation harnesses so the AI Coach can be tested automatically against scenario suites on every change. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision.

• Plan -> Approve -> Deliver: you propose the plan, get sign-off on direction, and own execution

• Comfortable being the only engineer initially: you learn the system from the code (there is limited as-built documentation) and make it yours

• Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place

• Judgement over heroics: this is a mental health product - safety thresholds and crisis handling are governed by legal and clinical sign-off, and you build the systems that enforce them

Requirements
What we're looking for:

• Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture

title: Finance Manager
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the role

As Finance Manager, UAE, you’ll take full ownership of finance for our UAE entity and act as Airwallex’s primary finance contact with the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE). You’ll make sure our UAE financial reporting, prudential, and regulatory obligations are met accurately and on time, and you’ll be the person the regulator turns to on all financial reporting matters.

You’ll join the EMEA Finance team and work closely with Compliance, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, and local management. This is a role for someone who wants to build: our UAE operating model and reporting cadence are still maturing, so you’ll shape how finance runs in the market from the ground up.

What you’ll do

- Act as the designated finance contact with the CBUAE for all financial and prudential reporting, including regulatory returns, ad hoc information requests, and supervisory meetings.

- Own the preparation, review, and submission of CBUAE regulatory returns, working with Compliance on interpretation and the regulatory calendar.

- Monitor and report on regulatory capital, liquidity, and safeguarding of client funds, flagging risks early and recommending action.

- Own the monthly close and financial control procedures for the UAE entity, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and P&L reviews before submission to FP&A.

- Prepare financial performance, capital, and cash commentary for local board packs and management reporting.

- Lead the annual statutory audit under IFRS and liaise with external auditors and advisors to resolve issues.

- Oversee UAE Corporate Tax and VAT compliance with our Tax team and external advisors.

- Support new product launches in the UAE by making sure they’re reflected correctly in our reporting structure and regulatory submissions.

- Drive process improvement and automation across UAE finance, and collaborate with the wider Controllership team on department-wide projects.

- Responsibilities of the role may develop over time.

What you bring

- A professional finance or accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CFA, or equivalent.

description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.
We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.
Simple - Reliable - Done Right!
The Role
Every job site we support depends on equipment, fuel, parts, and subcontractors; each tied to an invoice that must be accurate.. As our Accounts Payable Analyst, you will manage the full payables cycle from invoice intake and three-way matching to payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and month-end close.
This is more than processing. You will be the person who spots the coding error before it distorts job costs, who reconciles the vendor statement nobody else wants to touch, and who tells us what our spend is doing. As the business grows, you will help build the payables process that scales with it.
What You'll Do

• Process the payables volume. Review, code, and enter high volumes of vendor invoices, matching to purchase orders and receiving documentation and resolving discrepancies before they hit the ledger.

• Own job and GL coding accuracy. Code invoices to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs, and cost categories so project profitability and equipment costs stay clean.

• Run payments. Prepare and process check, ACH, and card payment runs on schedule, applying payment terms, discounts, and approval requirements.

• Reconcile vendor accounts. Reconcile vendor statements, research aged and unmatched items, and work directly with vendors to resolve disputes, credits, and short pays.

• Support month-end close. Prepare AP accruals, reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, and clear open items so close is not held up by payables.

• Report on payables and spend. Build and maintain aging, cash requirement, and vendor spend reporting, and flag trends and exceptions to the Manager, Accounts Payable and Accounting leadership.

• Improve the process. Identify the bottlenecks and recurring errors in the payables cycle, propose fixes, and help implement automation and workflow improvements in our systems.

• Keep vendor data and compliance clean. Maintain vendor master records, collect and verify W-9s, support 1099 preparation, and apply sales and use tax treatment correctly.

• Support audits and internal controls. Pull documentation and provide support for internal reviews and external audit requests, and follow approval and segregation of duties requirements.

• Partner with the field and operations. Work with managers, purchasing, and shop teams to chase down missing approvals, packing slips, and PO detail to ensure invoices are processed without delay

• Reconciling credit card accounts. Manage end-to-end reconciliation for high-volume corporate credit card accounts (50+ cards / $100K+ monthly volume), ensuring all transactions are matched with valid receipts, properly coded, and cleared against the general ledger. Investigate and resolve credit card transaction discrepancies, disputed charges, and unapplied credits with vendors and card-issuing banks.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of accounts payable experience, including full cycle, high volume processing

• Hands on experience with purchase order based invoicing and three-way match

• Experience reconciling vendor statements and the AP subledger to the general ledger

• Working knowledge of an ERP or accounting

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We build our lab automation ourselves. Instead of buying turnkey systems and running them through a vendor's GUI, we reverse-engineer instruments, control them with open-source Python tooling like PyLabRobot and PyHamilton , and build the software and hardware to turn a pile of instruments into work cells that run biology around the clock. title: Loans Manager for FLDG
description:
Company description
Netbank is a start-up fintech led bank, focused on the under-served. Its model is to:

• Partner with Fintechs, banks and non-bank lenders, who have existing client networks or are looking to enter the Philippines

• Allow these partners to sign-up clients, for an origination fee, booked on Netbank s balance sheet. Netbank would provide:

• Loans to clients, so the partners can grow without raising additional capital

• Deposit accounts for clients, serviced by the partner (on a white-label basis)

• Payment services to clients, including ACH payments, access to cards, payment to wallets, etc.

• Technology services to the partners, allowing them more efficient processing and better client satisfaction

Netbank Virtual is a product area of Netbank , offering banking as a service via APIs to local fintech and international fintech looking to enter the market. It expects to offer services in:

• Disburse funds: Payments via ACH, payments to wallets, payments to cash.

• Collect funds: Receive funds from the above channels

• Open transaction accounts / wallets

• Open loan accounts.

Netbank will offer segment specific solutions, aiming to roll-out products to a pilot client and then a range of similar clients.
Responsibilities:
This position is a member of the team responsible for services to lenders.
The FLDG Loans Manager is responsible for product and business development for cash loans, mostly under FLDG.
The steps in product development will be:

• Definition of product design to understand the data that can be gathered from the platform / payroll provider

• Understanding of the repayment process to ensure these loans are self-liquidating

• Assessment of size of loan partner, growth opportunity

• Identification of additional data that may be available on the end client

• Definition of data sources that can be used to assess creditworthiness.

• Creation of legal agreements / specific processes to reduce credit risk

• Definition of process design (document sharing, etc.)

• Legal and contractual work with the platform / with the borrower

• Product definition (term, tenor, etc.)

The steps in partner development will be:

• Understand the product that Netbank can provide to end clients.

• Listen carefully to the situation of these lenders and align our sales strategy to their situation

• Describe the solution and work with the partners as they develop the solution. Explain the regulation, the options, the financial implications.

• Provide advisory services to potential partners, to accelerate the on-boarding process and prove our culture of relentless implementation

• Commercial negotiation

• Support clients through implementation. Work closely with the clients to on-board them.

The steps in partner optimisation will be:

• Identify product enhancements which ensure we meet the full needs of our end clients around lending products.

• Identify causes of losses and ways to reduce these losses through credit risk mitigations

• Identify additional products to sell to the end clients, such as additional loans, accounts, insurance, etc.

• Identify how we can support internal processes of partners, such as by implementing collection accounts, etc.

As with all solutions providers, the position holder will need to:

• Deeply understand client needs for the proposed services and identify ways that Netbank can provide a product significantly better than the competition

• Implement the product to achieve this differentiation, including ensuring the technical system capabilities can meet client requirement

• Managing a highly professional sales and on-boarding process, which responds at the speed that Fintech demand, keeps partners fully informed through the implementation process.

• Identify additional services which clients need and propose these to clients. Identify product gaps and identify technical partnerships and technology solutions that allow us to offer these services.

• Along with your application, please submit a short test video.

Overview
At PrizePicks , we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth from real-time contest engines to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a talented and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our Back Office team and help us build the internal platform that powers every operation at PrizePicks .
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer fluent in both Ruby on Rails and Go to join our Back Office team. Back Office is the internal operational platform used by Game Ops, Trading, Member Operations, and Risk teams to configure projections, trade lines, manage members, review risk, and monitor live scoring - all of which directly shapes what millions of members see in the app.
In this role, you will design and build backend services that span our Rails monolith and our growing ecosystem of Rails and Go microservices. You will work across existing as well as new services being carved out as we migrate toward a microservices architecture. You will tackle high-scope, complex technical problems, own features end-to-end, and mentor engineers on your team. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable extending a mature Rails codebase and greenfielding a new Go service, and who is energized by the challenge of a platform in active, deliberate evolution.
What You'll Do

•
Build and own backend services : Design and implement features across both Rails-based services and Go microservices - from API contracts through deployment and monitoring.

•
Support the migration to microservices : Help decompose the Rails monolith into well-scoped, independently deployable services, contributing to architectural decisions about what to extract and how.

•
Power internal tooling APIs : Build and maintain the backend APIs that Back Office operators depend on for real-time decisioning - projection management, risk dashboards, alerting, and member operations.

•
Own technical delivery : Lead the design and implementation of complex features end-to-end, from product requirements through production deployment.

•
Drive system reliability : Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries, and improve resilience of backend systems under load.

•
Define technical direction : Propose and drive architectural decisions for your team's services, evaluating tradeoffs and communicating recommendations clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

•
Mentor and elevate : Provide hands-on mentorship to Software Engineers I, II, and III through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

•
Improve engineering practices : Advocate for and improve best practices around code quality, testing, observability, and deployment for the team.

•
Collaborate cross-functionally : Work closely with Product Managers, QA, and other engineering teams to translate operational goals into well-scoped technical solutions.

•
Participate in on-call rotation : Share responsibility for production incidents, contributing to root cause analysis and long-term reliability improvements.

What You Have
Experience:

• 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful production time in both Ruby on Rails and Go

• Proven track record of owning and delivering complex, multi-component features in a team environm

We help organizations bring about positive transformation to their businesses by leveraging intelligent applications of innovative solutions and pertinent services to remain winners in today's ultra-competitive marketplace.
With our strong network of technology partners, excellent domain expertise and differentiated value proposition, we are able to go above and beyond for our customers, far exceeding expectations.
Role Overview
We are seeking SOC Analysts to join our Managed Security Operations Center (SOC), supporting customers across ASEAN. You will monitor security alerts, investigate potential threats, manage incidents, and coordinate with customers and internal technical teams to ensure timely incident resolution.
This role follows a fixed day shift schedule 3 and a half day work week, 1 weekend off.
Working hours:
Full day: 13 hours shift (9am - 10pm)
Half day: 6.5 hours shift (9am - 3.30pm / 3pm - 9.30pm)
Job Responsibilities

• Monitor security alerts across multiple security platforms and identify potential threats.

• Triage and investigate alerts, analyse security logs, and distinguish true positives from false positives.

• Assess incident severity, gather indicators of compromise (IOCs), and document investigation findings.

• Manage and track security incidents in ServiceNow, ensuring compliance with SLAs.

• Communicate incident updates and recommendations to customers professionally.

• Escalate complex incidents to L3 analysts and the SOC Manager, and support containment and remediation activities.

• Maintain accurate incident records, shift handovers, and operational documentation.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, SIEM monitoring, incident management, identity security, endpoint protection, and email security.

• Familiarity with Microsoft security technologies, preferably Microsoft Defender.

• Basic knowledge of security log analysis, KQL, or PowerShell is an advantage.

• 1-2 years of experience in SOC operations, cybersecurity, or IT operations.

• Experience in a Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP) environment is an advantage.

• Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, SC-900, CompTIA Security+, or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity are preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Attention to detail and accurate documentation.

• Ability to work independently and remain effective under pressure.

• Willingness to work rotating shifts, if required.

title: Regional Associate, Growth & Competition (Portuguese-Speaking, Brazil / Spanish
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Portuguese-speaking Regional Associate to join a new outreach team supporting property hosts across Brazil and Spanish-speaking South America. In this role, you will use data to help hosts understand how their listings and pricing compare across booking platforms. You will also share education, tips, and insights that help them make informed decisions. This is a phone-heavy, relationship-driven role, a blend of business development and junior account management. It is well suited to someone early in their career who enjoys outbound outreach and building rapport quickly.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze listing optimization opportunities and performance trends across a portfolio of high-potential host accounts, and act on data-driven opportunities that help hosts attract more bookings

• Make a high volume of outbound calls, roughly 10-20 per day, and reach hosts through video meetings and email, following up consistently across channels

• Present data clearly using charts and approved tools, and explain the platform's value to hosts

• Help hosts understand how their pricing compares across booking platforms, and address common questions and objections

• Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integrations with various software partners

• Document conversations, classifications, and follow-ups in Salesforce, Gong, and team trackers

• Track progress toward quarterly goals and adjust your approach weekly

• Share learnings, objections, and best practices with the team

• Follow host communication guidelines at all times: educate and inform, provide objective, data-driven insights, and empower hosts to make their own pricing and business decisions

Qualifications

Required

• Fluency in Portuguese

• Comfort on the phone and on video, with the ability to build rapport quickly with people you have never met

• Comfort with outbound outreach and a high daily call volume

• Organized and self-directed, able to manage a large portfolio and a daily call plan

• Curiosity and comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, spot a pattern, and explain it simply

• Persistence and resilience: you can follow up many times, respectfully, without taking silence personally, and adapt quickly to different conversations

• Good judgment and integrity when working within compliance guidelines

Preferred

• Fluency in Spanish

• 1-2 years of experience in inside sales, business development, account management, or host or partner success and onboarding, ideally at a marketplace or tech platform

• Customer service, sales, or hospitality experience (internships count)

• Bachelor's degree completed or expected within the next 6 months (any field)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce), call-intelligence tools (Gong), or outreach tools (Mixmax)

• Experience with spreadsheets and dashboards (Google Sheets, Tableau)

• Interest in travel, short-term rentals, or online marketplaces

What to Expect

• A structured ramp-up with guided training and competitive intelligence sessions

• Tool walkthroughs with teammates for Salesforce, Gong, Mixmax, and team dashboards and trackers

• Shadowing on host calls during your first weeks

• Weekly performance data and regular coaching to support your growth

Key Details

• Start date: Mid-November 2026

• Duration: 6 months

• Location: Remote (within the U.S.), Eastern or Central time zone preferred

• Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (8 hours/day, 5 days/week)

• Pay rate range: $20-$23/hour + benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(K))

• Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

• Engagement: W-2 Contract

• Comfortable with ambiguity - you can pick up bleeding-edge LLM tools and make them productive without hand-holding

description:
About Deploy 
 
Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout.  Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.

Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.
 
Business Operations Associate Role 
 
We are looking for a talented leader to oversee business operations at Deploy. As a Business Operations Associate, you will be assisting the executive team with a variety of key activities, including improving existing processes and procedures to create effective structures for growth, implementing effective reporting and productivity goals for various teams, and tackling high impact ad hoc projects touching various company functions. Our ideal candidate has strong generalist skills, a proven background of leadership in a high-pressure environment, and an enthusiasm for digging deep into the metrics of various operations. Who We Are
 
We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Deploy, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.
 
Thank you for your interest in Deploy and we hope to meet you soon!

Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. title: Research Engineer, Intern – Benchmarking
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer at Mercor, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and applied AI research. You’ll own benchmarking pipelines, evaluation systems, and failure analysis workflows that directly inform how we train and improve frontier language models.
Your work will define how we measure tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning. You’ll design and run evals, build rubrics and scorers, and turn failure analysis into actionable improvements for post-training, RLVR, and data pipelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Benchmarking: Design, implement, and maintain benchmarks and metrics for tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning; ensure benchmarks scale with training and stay aligned with product and research goals.

- Evaluation systems: Build and operate LLM evaluation systems end-to-end runs, scoring, dashboards, and reporting, so researchers and applied AI teams can track model performance and compare runs at scale.

- Failure analysis: Run systematic failure analysis on model outputs (e.g., wrong tool use, reasoning errors, safety/alignment issues); categorize failure modes, quantify prevalence, and feed findings into reward design, data curation, and benchmark design.

- Rubrics and evaluators: Create and refine rubrics, automated evaluators, and scoring frameworks that drive training and evaluation decisions; balance rigor with scalability (human vs. model-as-judge, calibration, agreement).

- Data quality and usability: Quantify data usability, quality, and impact on key benchmarks; use evals and failure analysis to guide data generation, augmentation, and curation.

- Cross-team collaboration: Work with AI researchers, applied AI teams, and data producers to align evals with training objectives and to prioritize benchmarks and failure analyses that matter most.

- Ownership in a fast-paced environment: Operate in a high-iteration research setting with strong ownership of benchmarks, evals, and failure-analysis workflows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong applied research background, with focus on model evaluation, benchmarking, and/or failure analysis.

- Strong coding skills and hands-on experience with ML models and evaluation code.

- Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and backend systems.

- Comfort with APIs, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud platforms for running and storing eval results.

- Ability to reason about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality from evals and failure analyses.

- Excitement to work in person in San Francisco five days a week in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.

NICE TO HAVE

- Industry experience on a post-training or evaluation/benchmarking team (highest priority).

- Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL), especially in evaluation or benchmarking.

- Experience building or running LLM evaluations, benchmarks, or failure-analysis pipelines.

- Experience with synthetic data generation, rubric design, or RL-style workflows th

title: Data Engineer, Marketing
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.

What you'll do

- Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

- Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

- Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

- Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

- Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue

You may be a fit if

- You have 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

- You have strong SQL and python skills and are comfortable building both data pipelines and predictive models

- You've run hold-out or incrementality tests and worked with MMM and attribution models in production, and you know the limitations of each

- You understand how ad platforms report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and you don't take platform-reported numbers at face value

- You communicate clearly with channel managers, Finance, and leadership, and you're honest about what the data does and doesn't support

- You're self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end

title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

About the Role

9 Mothers builds hardware in Austin, TX, and this role is the single point of contact for everything that comes into or leaves our building. You own receiving end to end: every package, every packing list, every handoff to the person waiting on it. No prior experience is required. What matters most is that you are reliable and detail-oriented, because a shipment that is misplaced or logged wrong stalls the people who need it.

 

What You'll Do

- Receive every delivery to the building and check it against its packing list

- Log each shipment in our receiving system and keep packing lists filed and traceable

- Organize incoming packages so anything can be found quickly

- Notify recipients when their items arrive and hand them off

- For outbound shipments, package and label the item, drive it to the carrier, and confirm it has gone out

- Keep the receiving area clean and orderly

What We're Looking For

- Reliable: you are here every day, on time, and no delivery goes uncaught

- Detail-oriented: you check quantities and part numbers against the packing list and don't let a discrepancy slide

- Organized, with basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, or an inventory/receiving system)

- Valid driver's license and a clean driving record

- Able to lift and move packages up to 50 lb

- Prior receiving, shipping, warehouse, or inventory experience is a plus but not required

Hours & Location

- Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., onsite in Austin, TX

- The hours are fixed so someone is always on hand for every delivery window

 

Benefits

- Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

- Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

- Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

- The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

- 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

- Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

- Zero Red Tape: You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

- Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

- Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

1. Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call)

2. Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams)

3. Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in-person)

title: Senior Counsel, AI Product
description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.

About the Role

As a member of our AI Product Counsel team, you will help shape how frontier AI moves from research into products used around the world. Working cross-functionally across OpenAI, you will partner closely with product teams developing new models and experiences. Your work may span ChatGPT and Codex, including consumer and workplace offerings and integrated verticals in regulated areas. This is a unique opportunity to tackle novel legal questions and help shape the next generation of AI products.

This role is based in San Francisco or Washington, D.C., where we follow a hybrid schedule of three days in the office per week. Remote candidates will also be considered, and we offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Be the go-to counsel and partner for several teams focused on frontier AI models and products.

- Identify and address product, regulatory, copyright, commerce, privacy, and other legal risks and mitigations, including for industry verticals and consumer ChatGPT experiences.

- Develop strategies for handling legal issues in creative ways and build processes for scaling flexible solutions that address risk.

- Serve as an expert in AI legal matters and help propose and advance AI legal policy positions.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Have 8+ years of experience with a mix of in-house or technology-focused law firm roles.

- Understand the letter of the law and can approach problems in a practical, principled approach.

- Build cross-functional relationships and communication styles that resonate with teams to balance risk-taking with responsible development.

- Have a strong sense of ownership, are inquisitive and enthusiastic about technology, enjoy being continually challenged, and can demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous situations.

- Have a JD and license or qualification to practice in CA.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
